extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k Arabic book pages paired with their Markdown representations.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to form paired samples of Arabic book pages and Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: HTML content was converted to PDFs and Markdown text was extracted to create paired samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset consists of paired Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations generated from scraped HTML content.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work aims to contribute to document parsing and promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may not generalize well beyond Hindawi-derived content to other Arabic domains such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is derived from Hindawi web content and may not generalize to other Arabic domains; expanding it to diverse genres and styles is needed for robustness.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluation of Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction models.
